headline: Shanghai Masters: Medvedev beats Tsitsipas 6-4, 7-5; Quarterfinals set
whyCareReason: Daniil Medvedev defeated longtime rival Stefanos Tsitsipas in straight sets to reach the quarterfinals. Paul, Jodar and Ruud also advanced.
teaser: ATP time: 1:44:12. The quarterfinal lineup at Qizhong is officially locked: Zverev vs de Minaur, Gea vs Davidovich Fokina, Paul vs Ruud, Medvedev vs Jodar.
story: Daniil Medvedev defeated Stefanos Tsitsipas 6-4, 7-5 on Stadium Court in the Shanghai Masters round of 16 on Wednesday. The ATP lists the match at 1:44:12. Tommy Paul ended the upset run of Zizou Bergs with a 7-6 (5), 6-4 victory. Spanish 19-year-old Rafael Jodar rallied past Botic van de Zandschulp 6-7 (4), 6-4, 6-2 in 2:28:15. Casper Ruud advanced to the final eight after Felix Auger-Aliassime was forced to retire trailing 5-2 in the first set. Alexander Zverev has already secured year-end World No. 1. Jannik Sinner remains out for the season.
stakes: The quarterfinal matchups are set: top seed Zverev plays de Minaur, Gea meets Davidovich Fokina, Paul faces Ruud, and Medvedev battles the rising Spanish teenager Jodar.
rivalryAngle: Medvedev earned another chapter in his heated rivalry against Tsitsipas, advancing to his fourth Shanghai Masters quarterfinal.
funFacts: Paul (15) d. Bergs: 7-6 (5), 6-4. Jodar (12) d. van de Zandschulp: 6-7 (4), 6-4, 6-2. Ruud (20) d. Auger-Aliassime (4): 5-2, ret.
Quarterfinals locked: Zverev (1) vs de Minaur (9), Gea vs Davidovich Fokina (25), Paul (15) vs Ruud (20), Medvedev (5) vs Jodar (12).
